entities.name: Gryta
entities.description: An angel of the Flight of Herons on Innistrad.

entities.name: Flight of Herons
entities.description: Flight of angels to which Gryta belongs.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Angel who gave Gryta names for the honored list.

entities.name: Dovid
entities.description: A man tasked with cleaning the Lofts of Thraben, later honored with a silver sword.

entities.name: Lofts of Thraben cathedral
entities.description: Abandoned cathedral lofts angels may once more use.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: Artifact whose fragments yielded silver for swords.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: Eldrazi whose voices drive others mad.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: Leader of a flight Gryta may have joined.

events.summary: Avacyn tasked Dovid with cleaning the abandoned Lofts, with Gryta as guide.
events.quote: Gryta was to be his guide

events.summary: Gryta calmed Dovid's fear of heights and cast a spell giving him access to the Lofts.
events.quote: She then cast an angelic spell, giving Dovid magical access to enter the Lofts.

events.summary: Gryta added Dovid's name atop the list of honored Cathars to receive a silver sword from the Helvault.
events.quote: Gryta added Dovid's name at the top of the list of honored Cathars

relations.note: Took her instructions and list of names.
relations.quote: Gryta dictated a list of names she had received from Avacyn
Gryta is an angel of the Flight of Herons on Innistrad .
